title: zAAp Protocol
tagline: Save time and money with zAAp'd transactions. Combine multiple transactions into one and pay only one gas fee!
description:
⚡ zAAp Protocol

🏛️ Our dApp is a revolutionary tool that is designed to save time and money for users while interacting with any protocol on the blockchain. It achieves this through bundle transactions, where multiple transactions are combined into one and only one gas fee is charged, making it more affordable and convenient to interact with different protocols.

🏛️ zAAp offers users an affordable and convenient way to interact with different protocols. By bundling transactions into one and charging only one gas fee, a new era of adoption could be upon us. Now new web3 users can easily perform any transaction they desire without worrying about high gas fees or complex transaction processes.

What's up Next for zAAp?
🏆 zkSync Integrations - One successful integration down. Countless more to go. After zAAp's integration with SyncSwap to allow a multicall tx, many more integrations are planned. Including leading lending protocols, DEX's, NFT marketplaces, Privacy Layers, and Protocol Liquidity Pools.

🔀 Multichain Future - Interact with the most popular new chains using a batch tx system that brings bridge costs down 95%. Easier UX for Web3 users to interact with any protocol desired, seamlessly.

🟢  Many More Swaps - There are a multitude of diverse swaps that can be enabled with a multichain AA tx bundler. These be explored and implemented in the near future. 

⚡ Token and Community - Users holding zAAp tokens have the ability to vote up their favorite zAAps to help other users. If one holds zAAp, the user can create or suggest a new zAAp.
